summary: Quote on an NSE equity: a 1501-json-partial event carrying only the last price (an object payload at the root, no Touchline) becomes a Quote frame whose other fields are 0 and whose ltt is the receipt time.

notes: Audit appendix (family) inherited item 1: neither side keeps a quote snapshot, so fields a partial does not carry go out as 0 on both. Pinned as today's behaviour; the desktop must leave them out (rules: no invented data).
The partial carries no LastTradedTime: the desktop sends the receipt time as ltt (feed::bridge::ltt), the web 0.

deviations.reason: The partial carries no average_price; both sides fill it with 0 because neither keeps a quote snapshot (audit appendix, inherited item 1), the web as the int 0 and the desktop as 0.0. The desktop must leave it out (rules: no invented data; audit C03).

The partial carries no close; both sides fill it with 0 because neither keeps a quote snapshot (audit appendix, inherited item 1), the web as the int 0 and the desktop as 0.0. The desktop must leave it out (rules: no invented data; audit C03).

The partial carries no high; both sides fill it with 0 because neither keeps a quote snapshot (audit appendix, inherited item 1), the web as the int 0 and the desktop as 0.0. The desktop must leave it out (rules: no invented data; audit C03).

The partial carries no low; both sides fill it with 0 because neither keeps a quote snapshot (audit appendix, inherited item 1), the web as the int 0 and the desktop as 0.0. The desktop must leave it out (rules: no invented data; audit C03).

The event carries no trade time: the web sends 0, the desktop the time it received the event (feed::bridge::ltt). A receipt time is not a trade time (rules: no invented data): the XTS feed should mark the trade time absent (QuoteField::LastTradeTime) so ltt is left out.
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The partial carries no open; both sides fill it with 0 because neither keeps a quote snapshot (audit appendix, inherited item 1), the web as the int 0 and the desktop as 0.0. The desktop must leave it out (rules: no invented data; audit C03).
